criteria.requirement: The 24x18m 3D warehouse shows four shelving rows, end cross-aisles, packing station and six distinct bins for the specified SKUs/quantities.
criteria.action: Inspect the warehouse layout, dimensions, bins and initial order.
criteria.expected: The 24x18m warehouse has four shelving rows, end cross-aisles, packing station and the six specified SKUs/quantities in distinct bins.

criteria.requirement: Order quantities, item removal and stop order are editable, with a useful initial order ready to play.
criteria.action: Edit quantities, remove an item and reorder stops.
criteria.expected: Changes apply to a useful initially runnable order.

criteria.requirement: Each leg follows a shortest walkable path in the chosen order from packing through bins and back; routes avoid shelf footprints and show total meters.
criteria.action: Inspect each route leg and distance for different stop orders.
criteria.expected: Packing-to-bin-to-packing legs use shortest walkable paths for the chosen order, avoid shelves and show total meters; global stop optimization is not required.

criteria.requirement: Animated picking stops at the appropriate shelf faces and updates the matching picked quantities.
criteria.action: Play the route and inspect stops and picked quantities.
criteria.expected: The picker follows the route, stops at the corresponding shelf faces and updates the correct order items.

criteria.requirement: Play/pause/speed/restart work and editing the order resets playback/checklist rather than retaining stale progress.
criteria.action: Pause, change speed, restart and edit the order during or after playback.
criteria.expected: Transport behaves consistently and edits reset playback/checklist to avoid stale progress.

criteria.requirement: Blocked aisle segments trigger rerouting or identify unreachable items and prevent starting an impossible route.
criteria.action: Block an aisle segment to create a detour and then an unreachable item.
criteria.expected: Routes recalculate where possible; unreachable items are identified and impossible playback is prevented.

criteria.requirement: Overhead planning and following playback views retain a usable order list.
criteria.action: Switch overhead planning and following views while preparing/playing an order.
criteria.expected: Both views retain a usable order list and relevant route context.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect warehouse geometry, bins, initial order and packing-to-packing route.
Run/pause picking, change speed and camera, then edit quantities or stop order and verify playback/checklist reset.
Block an aisle to force a detour, then isolate an item and check unreachable feedback and disabled playback; clear blockage and restart.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
